svg.text: OSPF between R1 and R2 (IOS XE 17.x) is stuck in EXSTART. Using only the outputs below, find the most likely

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cause. Do not invent commands; say if you need more data.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pasted: show ip ospf neighbor + interface MTU lines (sanitised, internal). Removed: enable secret, TACACS+ key,

svg.text: Answer as a table: Cause | Evidence line | Fix command | Risk — then a 3-step verification plan.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Restricted data never goes in: passwords, enable secrets, pre-shared keys, SNMP communities, private keys, TACACS+/RADIUS keys.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Selecting the best prompt: discard any that leaks restricted data → prefer a specific task with constraints → a fitting persona

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: → a checkable output format → real evidence instead of guesses.
